note_reply: No note from the front office this week, and holy cow, I'll take the silence as a standing ovation! Six-and-one, folks, and when the lineup card's working you don't go tearin' it up just to hear yourself talk. We're ridin' into November with the fellas that got us here!
forum_post: HOLY COW, folks, marquee matchup number two against ol' Georgie Costanza this week, and I read every word of it in the Dispatch like scripture! Georgie, pal, I love ya, but the refs don't know how ANYTHING ends, they're just out there blowin' whistles like the rest of us tryin' to have a good time -- five-and-two with the league outscorin' ya is the most beautiful kind of lucky there is, and I mean that with zero hard feelings, none, zero! Meanwhile my fella Zay Flowers went for TWENTY-THREE, Bijan Robinson's runnin' like he's late for a train, and Aaron Rodgers -- future Hall of Famer, I don't care what anybody says -- is slingin' it around like it's 2011 all over again! And hey, word on the street is somebody in this very building scouted up my kicker Boswell for me -- whoever you are, pal, drinks are on me, that eleven-spot was a thing of beauty! Six-and-one and smilin' every single day. Good luck Sunday, Georgie -- swing away, buddy, swing away!
